title: GameWorkspaceChips
responsibility: Shows the status chips in the Game Views header: demo, the historical commit, read-only and unsaved changes.

inputs.name: GameWorkspaceChips.commit
inputs.description: The historical commit being shown. A truthy string renders a History chip using shortCommit; an absent or empty string renders no History chip.

inputs.name: GameWorkspaceChips.readonly
inputs.description: Whether the workspace is read-only. The component renders a Read-only chip only when this is true and commit is falsy.

inputs.name: GameWorkspaceChips.dirty
inputs.description: Whether there are edits not saved yet. When true, the component renders an Unsaved changes chip.

outputs.name: GameWorkspaceChips
outputs.description: A markup fragment containing inline pills in this order when applicable: History, Read-only, and Unsaved changes. History uses shortCommit(commit), and Read-only appears only when readonly is true and commit is falsy.
